title: Gary V sings about Gabo’s triumphant journey in new theme song for “Sigabo”
summary: Gary Valenciano gives life to Gabo’s (Coco Martin) exciting journey ahead with his poignant rendition of “Kung Kailangan Mo Ako,” the new theme song of “Coco Martin’s Sigabo.”
